rules.notToken: a unit of account inside the files; never a token, never transferred for sale, never in a wallet
rules.schedule: straight-line: each door may issue the same share of a tranche; nothing may be issued ahead of its door
rules.fungible: a unit carries no history that changes what it is worth; a unit issued at door 1 and a unit issued at door 200 are the same unit, and every deck must accept either without asking which
rules.chances: the cap is a budget of attempts, not a scarcity: 21,000,000 units is 21,000,000 chances to act, and a chance not taken is not saved, it is only not taken
rules.centralized: the prices are decentralized, door by door; the effort is centralized at the syndicates, where every door's events are reconciled into one chain and the doors find out what the others did
rules.balances: replay only: a balance is the sum of the events, never a number kept on its own
rules.write: two of three custodians sign an event, or it is not an event
rules.chain: every event hashes the one before it, SHA-256 and SHA3-256 both; a Merkle checkpoint per door
rules.exit: redeem is the only way a unit leaves; there is no burn and no sale
rules.syndication: the chain is syndicated between worlds every six months, an interplanetary interval; between syndications each side keeps its own events and reconciles at the next
rules.procurement: inward: the ship procures from within; water and food are free and unpriced on every deck

text: The docket's rulebook: what holds from door 1 to door 200. Not editable; the ledger enforces it, and a changed copy kept in the browser is ignored by every deck.
